newsitem.title: GERMANY: Degussa shares up on strong profit figures.
newsitem.headline: Degussa shares up on strong profit figures.

text.p: Shares in the German chemicals and metals group Degussa AG traded strongly ahead on Tuesday after the group said pre-tax profits jumped 20 percent in the first quarter of the 1996/97 business year.
Degussa shares were up six marks, or 0.84 percent, at 722 marks in pre-bourse electronic trade on the IBIS DAX index, having earlier traded as high as 730 marks.
The overall IBIS DAX index was up 0.25 percent at 3,006.56 points.
Degussa said pre-tax profits were up 20 percent in the first quarter of the year to the end of September 1997, but did not give any further details and did not give specific reasons for the rise.
